Screenshots for the main README.

* `themes.jpg`: the eight built-in wallpapers (generated by `tools/make-gallery.py`).
* `desktop.png`, `coding.png`, `focus.png`, `accounts.png`, `tour.gif`: made-up data, created with `tools/demo.py`.
* `lockscreen.png`: a real capture of the lock screen (counts only), cropped to leave out the top bar and notifications.
